name: kubecon-cfp
description: Interactive KubeCon CFP submission writer with data-driven insights from 1,100+ accepted talks and official reviewer criteria.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and refine KubeCon CFP submissions
interface.longDescription: Turns a rough talk idea into a KubeCon/CloudNativeCon CFP: topic assessment against 1,100+ accepted talks, title options, abstract, benefits section, and scoring against the official reviewer criteria.
defaultPrompt: Use $kubecon-cfp to turn this talk idea into a KubeCon submission.
Use $kubecon-cfp to review and score my KubeCon CFP draft.
Use $kubecon-cfp to draft a lightning talk proposal for the Security track.
